provenance.prompt:
Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas with exactly four side-by-side views of the same Early Arenas gated stone bridge, in order FRONT, RIGHT, LEFT, REAR. The attached native source and accepted TOP/BOTTOM define a narrow horizontal stone walkway running along world Y, with a barred black-metal gate across the FRONT/south end and matching short stone parapet/posts on both sides. Use the source as identity authority and accepted plan views for exact orientation. Do not use the hybrid top-down source as a camera angle.

Strict axis-aligned orthographic views, no isometric/perspective/foreshortening, fixed world orientation. FRONT looks from -Y toward the gate end: show one straight-on low gate elevation across the short width, barred gate centered between two stone end posts, stone walkway side edges receding only as very thin depth, no full top-down walkway rectangle. REAR looks from +Y at the opposite end: show the far stone cross-end/parapet and walkway edge, not the front gate bars repeated. RIGHT and LEFT look from +/-X at the long bridge sides: each must show one long horizontal stone parapet/sidewall running along Y, a low continuous walkway/beam edge and the correct repeated stone posts; the gate appears only as a small vertical end edge at the FRONT endpoint, never as the whole image. Right/left are long side elevations, not gate-end views and not narrow vertical posts.

Keep identical scale, height and materials across directions. Stone parapets and posts are gray-beige masonry; gate bars are dark iron only at the front end. No invented doors, extra rails, banners, or structures. Four isolated complete views, transparent margins, no labels, no shadows, crisp Pocket Dungeon pixel-art clusters.
provenance.notes: Root-scoped-accepted principal end elevation installed with current source and all-six hash guards. FRONT/REAR use v4 low gate end profiles (173x56); RIGHT/LEFT use v2 accepted long parapet profiles. TOP/BOTTOM retained.
